articles.title_en: Heterogeneous Individual Valuations of a Mild Climate
articles.title_cn: 温和气候的异质性个体估值
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores heterogeneous individual valuations of an important amenity, climate mildness, using a traditional Rosen-Roback empirical framework. It does so by including interaction terms between the amenity and worker characteristics in an hedonic wage regression that also includes a housing-price measure. The results suggest that non-young workers (those in the mid-age and old groups) value a mild climate more than do young workers, matching the usual view that the tolerance for cold weather declines with age. The findings also suggest that, like their highly educated counterparts, workers with low education levels also highly value a mild climate, with workers in the middle range of education having a lower valuation. These findings, which contradict the view that only better-off individuals care about amenities, could reflect the lower burden in mild weather of the manual work done by the less educated. In addition to presenting these empirical findings, the paper further contributes by presenting new analytics for the Rosen-Roback model in a setting with individual heterogeneity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用传统的罗森-罗巴克实证框架，探讨了重要舒适性——气候温和度的异质性个体估值。通过在特征工资回归中加入舒适性与工人特征的交互项，并同时纳入房价指标，本文进行了分析。结果表明，非年轻工人（中年和老年群体）比年轻工人更看重温和气候，这与通常认为的耐寒能力随年龄增长而下降的观点相符。研究结果还表明，与高教育水平的工人一样，低教育水平的工人也高度重视温和气候，而中等教育水平的工人估值较低。这些发现与只有经济状况较好的人关心舒适性的观点相悖，可能反映了温和天气下受教育程度较低者从事体力劳动的负担较轻。除呈现这些实证发现外，本文还通过在个体异质性情境下为罗森-罗巴克模型提供新的分析，进一步做出了贡献。

articles.title_en: Saving or Investing for the Future? Methodology Matters in Inclusive Wealth Accounting
articles.title_cn: 为未来储蓄还是投资？包容性财富核算中的方法论至关重要
articles.abstract_en: At the 57th session of the UN Statistical Commission, methodological guidelines for wealth accounting were identified as a priority for the Beyond GDP agenda. Our paper contributes directly to this need. Genuine Savings (GS), a leading sustainable development indicator in environmental and resource economics, measures changes in inclusive wealth by adjusting national savings for natural capital depletion, physical capital depreciation, and human capital investment. An unappreciated issue is that the distinction between savings-based (GS) and investment-based (GI) measures is treated as semantic. In theory, both are identical given the savings-investment identity underpinning the national accounts. In practice, this identity does not always hold, due to statistical discrepancies and accounting revisions, with the savings side particularly susceptible. This paper is the first to examine how savings-investment discrepancies in the national accounts affect practical wealth accounting. Using data for thirty-three countries and two datasets (World Bank and AMECO), we show that GS and GI disagree, within and across datasets, by more than double the natural capital adjustment itself, enough to generate conflicting sustainability signals in both level and direction of change. These issues are persistent in the World Bank data, the primary global dataset for wealth accounting, while AMECO is largely internally consistent after 1995. Structural break analysis suggests supply and use balancing under the ESA95 revisions, together with reconciliation of the current account balance, reduces the disagreement. We provide practical guidance, including a formal GS-GI distinction, routine savings-investment consistency checks, a more central role for national statistics offices, and an uncertainty band of 3 percentage points of GNI to replace the binary zero threshold.
articles.abstract_cn: 在联合国统计委员会第57届会议上，财富核算的方法论指南被确定为“超越GDP”议程的优先事项。我们的论文直接服务于这一需求。真实储蓄（GS）是环境与资源经济学中领先的可持续发展指标，它通过调整国民储蓄以考虑自然资本耗竭、物质资本折旧和人力资本投资，来衡量包容性财富的变化。一个未被充分认识的问题是，基于储蓄（GS）和基于投资（GI）的测度之间的区别被视为语义上的。理论上，鉴于支撑国民账户的储蓄-投资恒等式，两者是相同的。在实践中，由于统计差异和核算修订，这一恒等式并不总是成立，储蓄方尤其容易受到影响。本文首次考察国民账户中的储蓄-投资差异如何影响实际财富核算。利用三十三个国家和两个数据集（世界银行和AMECO）的数据，我们表明GS和GI在数据集内部和数据集之间不一致，其差异超过自然资本调整本身的两倍，足以在变化水平和方向上产生相互矛盾的可持续性信号。这些问题在世界银行数据——财富核算的主要全球数据集——中持续存在，而AMECO在1995之后基本内部一致。结构性断点分析表明，ESA95修订下的供给和使用平衡，连同经常账户余额的调节，减少了这种不一致。我们提供实用指导，包括正式的GS-GI区分、常规的储蓄-投资一致性检查、国家统计机构更核心的作用，以及用占GNI的3个百分点的不确定性区间来取代二元零阈值。

articles.title_en: Synergies and Welfare Effects of Combining Carbon Pricing and Renewable-Energy Policies: A Meta-Analysis
articles.title_cn: 碳定价与可再生能源政策相结合的协同效应与福利效应：一项元分析
articles.abstract_en: Many countries combine carbon pricing with renewable-energy policies. Microeconomic theory predicts this combination yields no additional emissions reductions under cap-and-trade and only potentially under carbon taxation, but at a social welfare loss. We undertook a systematic literature review of emissions-reduction synergy, identifying many ex-ante but only one ex-post study – explained by the lack of policy counterfactuals. In 72% of ex-ante 127 estimates from 80 studies, combining instruments reduces emissions more than either instrument alone. Additional reductions are more common under carbon taxation, as theory predicts, but also occur under cap-and-trade. Across 85 exact synergy estimates, the policy combination yields about 22% greater emissions reductions on average. Regarding welfare effects, 74 of 119 ex-ante estimates from 79 papers indicate some benefit from adding a second instrument. Deviations from theory reflect model assumptions, such as incomplete emissions coverage, implementation constraints, social welfare metrics limited to consumer utility, and market or government failures including fossil fuel subsidies. While ex-post estimates are less likely to detect non-zero synergy, the single ex-post study broadly supports our findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多国家将碳定价与可再生能源政策相结合。微观经济理论预测，在总量管制与交易下，这种结合不会带来额外的减排，只有在碳税下才可能带来额外减排，但会伴随社会福利损失。我们对减排协同效应进行了系统性文献综述，识别出许多事前研究，但仅有一项事后研究——这可由缺乏政策反事实来解释。在来自80项研究的127个事前估计中，有72%个表明，组合使用政策工具比单独使用任一工具减排更多。正如理论所预测，额外减排在碳税下更为常见，但在总量管制与交易下也会出现。在85个精确协同效应估计中，政策组合平均带来约22%的额外减排。关于福利效应，来自79篇论文的119个事前估计中有74个表明，增加第二种工具带来了一定收益。与理论的偏离反映了模型假设，例如排放覆盖不完整、实施约束、仅限于消费者效用的社会福利指标，以及包括化石燃料补贴在内的市场或政府失灵。虽然事后估计更不可能检测到非零协同效应，但唯一一项事后研究广泛支持了我们的发现。

articles.title_en: Cleaner Domestic Growth from a Globalization-Oriented Big Push: Evidence from China’s Belt and Road Initiative
articles.title_cn: 全球化导向的大推动带来的更清洁国内增长：来自中国“一带一路”倡议的证据
articles.abstract_en: China’s Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) is a large-scale outward-oriented big-push policy. This paper examines the domestic environmental performance of the BRI using city-level panel data on CO2 emissions and ambient PM2.5 concentrations from 2006 to 2019. Employing difference-in-differences designs with both a standard binary treatment specification and a treatment-intensity specification, we find that China’s inland BRI cities reduced carbon emission intensity by approximately 14% following BRI’s formal implementation in 2015. Meanwhile, local air quality does not exhibit systematic deterioration. These results are robust to a range of checks, including alternative estimators based on augmented synthetic control methods and different emissions inventories. We also provide suggestive evidence on two potential mechanisms through which the outward-oriented nature of the BRI may mitigate the environmental costs typically associated with big-push development strategies. First, improved market access may incentivize firms to invest in green capital expenditures and engage in green innovation. Second, increased external visibility may incentivize pro-growth governments to place greater weight on environmental outcomes, while relying more on non-production-side policy instruments.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国的“一带一路”倡议（BRI）是一项大规模外向型的大推动政策。本文利用2006至2019年间城市层面的CO2排放和周围PM2.5浓度面板数据，考察了BRI的国内环境绩效。采用双重差分设计，包括标准二元处理设定和处理强度设定，我们发现，在2015年BRI正式实施后，中国内陆BRI城市的碳排放强度降低了约14%。同时，当地空气质量并未出现系统性恶化。这些结果在一系列检验中保持稳健，包括基于增强合成控制方法的替代估计量和不同的排放清单。我们还提供了关于两个潜在机制的建议性证据，通过这些机制，BRI的外向型性质可能减轻通常与大推动发展战略相关的环境成本。首先，改善的市场准入可能激励企业投资于绿色资本支出并参与绿色创新。其次，增加的外部可见性可能激励增长导向型政府更加重视环境结果，同时更多依赖非生产侧政策工具。

articles.title_en: From Willingness to Engage to Demand: A Behavioral Experiment on Green Consumer Information in a Digital Product Passport
articles.title_cn: 从参与意愿到需求：数字产品护照中绿色消费者信息的行为实验
articles.abstract_en: Existing evidence shows consumers are willing to pay for labeled environmental attributes. However, there is a gap regarding whether consumers have a willingness to engage (WTE) with detailed information. The European Union’s circular economy action plan provides for a new Digital Product Passport (DPP), holding information including embedded emissions, components and materials, chemical substances, and instructions for repair, disassembly and sustainable disposal. In our theory, a green consumer decides how much to engage with information that helps them mitigate their environmental damage from consumption, given a cognitive or time cost. We test the model using a lab experiment where environmental attributes of a good are only available through a DPP. We find education on the DPP’s purpose is key to increasing revealed WTE with a DPP. This is driven by those with a lower stated WTE; participants with a high stated WTE interact with the DPP regardless. Engagement with the DPP increases knowledge and willingness to pay (WTP), as the DPP reveals favorable environmental information. We find no evidence of positive spillovers from the DPP (no further shifts in environmental orientation or increased subsequent behavior), but we find evidence that increases in WTP due to the DPP, and exposure to the DPP, lead to a negative spillover in a subsequent behavior (environmental donation). We further contribute novel measures of stated and revealed WTE, and demonstrate their value in understanding consumer behavior in a theoretically informed manner. Our study provides insights for field testing and rollout of a DPP or similar.
articles.abstract_cn: 现有证据表明，消费者愿意为带有标签的环境属性付费。然而，关于消费者是否有意愿参与（WTE）详细信息的方面仍存在空白。欧盟的循环经济行动计划规定了一种新的数字产品护照（DPP），其中包含嵌入排放、组件和材料、化学物质以及维修、拆卸和可持续处置说明等信息。在我们的理论中，绿色消费者在考虑认知或时间成本的情况下，决定参与多少有助于减轻其消费造成的环境损害的信息。我们通过一个实验室实验来检验该模型，其中商品的环境属性仅通过DPP提供。我们发现，关于DPP目的的教育是提高已揭示的DPP参与意愿的关键。这主要是由那些声明参与意愿较低的参与者驱动的；声明参与意愿高的参与者无论如何都会与DPP互动。参与DPP增加了知识和支付意愿（WTP），因为DPP揭示了有利的环境信息。我们没有发现DPP产生正向溢出效应的证据（环境取向没有进一步转变，后续行为也没有增加），但我们发现，由于DPP导致的WTP增加以及接触DPP，会在后续行为（环境捐赠）中产生负向溢出效应。我们进一步贡献了声明和揭示的参与意愿的新测量方法，并展示了它们在以理论为依据理解消费者行为方面的价值。我们的研究为DPP或类似产品的现场测试和推广提供了见解。

articles.title_en: Humid Heat, Health, and Behavioral Adaptation: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 湿热、健康与行为适应：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Rising humid heat poses significant risks to health and welfare. Using high-resolution meteorological data linked to longitudinal survey data from China, we examine relationships between humid heat measured by wet-bulb temperature (WBT) and self-reported physical and mental health. Higher WBT is associated with greater physical discomfort, concentrated in gastrointestinal and cardiovascular symptoms, and higher psychological distress. Relative to dry-bulb temperature, WBT exhibits a more robust relationship with mental health. These responses are largest among individuals with chronic conditions and low-income groups. Elevated WBT also triggers behavioral adjustments, including reduced work hours and exercise alongside increased alcohol and tobacco use. These patterns highlight welfare costs extending beyond clinical endpoints and underscore the importance of accounting for humidity in assessments of climate impacts on health.
articles.abstract_cn: 日益加剧的湿热对健康与福利构成重大风险。利用与中国纵向调查数据相关联的高分辨率气象数据，我们考察了以湿球温度（WBT）衡量的湿热与自报身心健康之间的关系。较高的湿球温度与更大的身体不适相关，主要集中在胃肠和心血管症状，并与更高的心理困扰相关。相对于干球温度，湿球温度与心理健康的关系更为稳健。这些反应在患有慢性疾病和低收入群体中最为显著。湿球温度的升高还会引发行为调整，包括减少工作时间和锻炼，同时增加酒精和烟草的使用。这些模式凸显了超出临床终点的福利成本，并强调了在评估气候对健康影响时考虑湿度的重要性。

articles.title_en: The Effectiveness of Carbon Pricing: A Global Evaluation
articles.title_cn: 碳定价的有效性：一项全球评估
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the effect of the staggered adoption of carbon pricing policies across the globe between 1990 and 2017 on per capita $$\text{CO}_2$$ emissions from fossil fuel combustion. We use recent econometric techniques robust to treatment effect heterogeneity. Our dynamic treatment effect estimations indicate gradual adjustments after implementation, resulting in a 19 to 23 percent decrease in $$\text{CO}_2$$ emissions after 10 years. These effects were primarily driven by resource substitution rather than improvements in energy efficiency and were not driven by short-term responses to carbon prices. Our results are robust to controlling for the potential effects of renewable energy policies. These results highlight the role of carbon pricing policies in steering medium-term expectations and complementing the climate policy mix.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了全球在1990至2017年间逐步采用碳定价政策对化石燃料燃烧产生的二氧化碳人均排放量的影响。我们使用了近期对处理效应异质性稳健的计量经济学技术。我们的动态处理效应估计表明，实施后调整是渐进的，导致在10年后二氧化碳排放量下降19至23%。这些效应主要由资源替代而非能源效率改进驱动，且并非由对碳价格的短期反应所驱动。我们的结果在控制可再生能源政策的潜在影响后依然稳健。这些结果凸显了碳定价政策在引导中期预期和补充气候政策组合中的作用。
